How do I make random bezier curves using randomized vertex positions on a canvas (above a background image)?. This is the code I'm currently using (I'm only getting a black background, no shapes are being drawn): index.html : Document
script.js function rand(min, max) { const minCeiled = Math.ceil(min); const maxFloored = Math.floor(max); return Math.floor(Math.random() * (maxFloored - minCeiled) + minCeiled); } const getRandom = rand(1, 1000); function setup() { createCanvas(1000, 1000); } function draw() { background(0); stroke(255); strokeWeight(20); noFill(); beginShape(); vertex(getRandom, getRandom) bezierVertex(getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom); bezierVertex(getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom); bezierVertex(getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom); bezierVertex(getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom); bezierVertex(getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom); bezierVertex(getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom); bezierVertex(getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom, getRandom); endShape(); } I watched YouTube videos, googled so many things, read through both the ps5 documentation and MDN and have no clue how to do this.
